shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile, low relief on a large upright slab
animal with elongated body, bent legs and clearly rendered head/snout
figures set against an otherwise plain flat field
justification: Both surfaces carry a schematic profile quadruped rendered in shallow relief on a large flat upright face, with an elongated body, angular bent limbs and a distinct snout — a reasonably specific shared convention, and B contains a comparable striding animal among its motifs. The decisive difference is compositional content: A shows a single isolated creature on an otherwise empty field, while B is a crowded multi-register programme with a row of arch-like motifs, a patterned band, birds, a snake and other figures stacked above one another.
